description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for testing and mocking embedded Pi session subscriptions, message handling, and event extraction in a testing harness for an AI assistant system.

methods.name: createStubSessionHarness
methods.description: Creates a mock session with a subscribe method and an emit function for testing.

methods.name: createSubscribedSessionHarness
methods.description: Creates a session with a subscription, combining a stub session with additional session properties.

methods.name: createParagraphChunkedBlockReplyHarness
methods.description: Sets up a session harness for chunked paragraph reply testing with specified chunking parameters.

methods.name: createTextEndBlockReplyHarness
methods.description: Sets up a session harness for text end reply testing with optional chunking.

methods.name: extractAgentEventPayloads
methods.description: Extracts data payloads from agent event calls.

methods.name: extractTextPayloads
methods.description: Extracts text payloads from call data.

methods.name: emitMessageStartAndEndForAssistantText
methods.description: Emits start and end message events for assistant text.

methods.name: emitAssistantTextDeltaAndEnd
methods.description: Emits a delta update and end event for assistant text.

methods.name: emitAssistantTextDelta
methods.description: Emits a delta update for assistant text.

methods.name: emitAssistantTextEnd
methods.description: Emits an end event for assistant text, optionally with content.

methods.name: emitAssistantLifecycleErrorAndEnd
methods.description: Emits an error message and end event for assistant lifecycle errors.

methods.name: createReasoningFinalAnswerMessage
methods.description: Creates a final answer message with reasoning.

methods.name: findLifecycleErrorAgentEvent
methods.description: Finds a lifecycle error event from a list of calls.

methods.name: expectFencedChunks
methods.description: Asserts that call chunks start with a specific prefix and contain fenced code blocks.

methods.name: expectSingleAgentEventText
methods.description: Asserts that a single agent event payload matches expected text.
